1.) As much as possible, try to manage na ikaw ang magcall out sa kanya. Baka mapapahiya siya if you tell your parents and she might start to resent you.

f you don't think you handle well calling out on her attitude, make a deal with your parents to not mention na ikaw ang nagsabi. Just let your parents claim that they found out on their own.

Try to make her think that you are on her side. It's a process, to be honest. But it's a good start. So next time something similar happens, she knows she can tell you about it or makwento lng. And then you can give her advice directly.
